review_kind: ordinary fresh advisory reviewer; no native Goal, candidate receipt or delegation
overall_assessment: Six material defects prevent acceptance. All consequential scientific claim groups and all 27 mapped primary entries were covered at frozen-source scope; historical execution/capture causality remains UNASSESSED. The conservative diagnostic grade makes no full SourcePASS claim for that remainder.

assessment_extent.scientific_semantic_extent: All stated material recommendations/facts/conditions, positive/negative/optional leads, uncertainty categories, six proposed checks, identity and source version assertions in this exact final were evaluated. Relevant governing primary sections and caller/callee paths were read; irrelevant RFC/package content is not claimed comprehensively audited.
assessment_extent.m14_semantic_projection_preservation_app: NOT_APPLICABLE: this is D-M16-A and the map contains no M14 authored semantic/projection/preservation set.

unassessed_remainder.item: Candidate historical 10-file, 28-locator, 5-capture operation counts, actual read scope, no-code/no-tests historical assertions, body-discard claim
unassessed_remainder.reason: No admissible activity/command logs; candidate reports and indices are inventory claims, not proof. Unmapped spotcheck, predecessor artifacts, timings and history are explicitly excluded.

unassessed_remainder.item: Actual original tile request method/headers/User-Agent, exact denial cause, client dependence and content of discarded response bodies
unassessed_remainder.reason: The two held header snapshots have no request metadata or bodies. They prove recorded header classes only; this review made no new tile request.

unassessed_remainder.item: End-to-end runtime behavior of uncaptured downloader delegates, queue persistence, deployed viewer UI/storage and future provider survey
unassessed_remainder.reason: Only bounded source inference is possible; proposed checks were not executed and no implementation was supplied.

six_axis_dispositions.name: All required obligations
six_axis_dispositions.reason: All six obligations are structurally addressed; the complete source-linked recommendation has material governing-condition errors.

six_axis_dispositions.name: Consequential claims and release/default/type/unit/path/authority conditions
six_axis_dispositions.reason: 58 claim groups were independently checked against exact source passages/metadata. Several material assertions and inferred requirements fail; source identities alone were not treated as answers.

six_axis_dispositions.name: Bounded useful discovery, negative and optional yield
six_axis_dispositions.reason: Useful tile storage, validators, backoff, stale extensions, namespace and purge mechanisms are found; optional leads retained. Offline-provider alternatives and actual denial/fallback distinctions were lost; package-wide negative behavior is not proved.

six_axis_dispositions.name: Wrong reject, correction and unjustified abstention
six_axis_dispositions.reason: The osmdroid backoff correction is right. Blanket blocking-refresh rejection and exclusive re-key requirement are not. Product retention choice and queue/source surveys appropriately remain open; HTTP freshness precedence itself is already settled by the RFC.

six_axis_dispositions.name: Preservation, traceability, uncertainty and options
six_axis_dispositions.reason: Versions, source families, independent topic unknowns and four optional leads survive. Important option defaults, source-policy scope, capture causality, cache types and retention triggers do not. Several locators point to a constructor or adjoining section.

six_axis_dispositions.name: Proposed versus executed checks
six_axis_dispositions.reason: Six proposed tests are clearly separated from self-reported static/probe work. Historical counts/commands/request headers are not authenticated by the allowed bytes; 28 versus 26+2+1 is ambiguous. This reviewer has not executed the proposed tests.

obligation_coverage.obligation: Give a separate disposition for acquisition and refresh.
obligation_coverage.assessment: Acquisition and refresh are separate, but skip/policy/denial conclusions need conditions.

obligation_coverage.obligation: Give a separate disposition for stale display and retention.
obligation_coverage.assessment: Display and retention are separate, but stale authority and cleanup bounds need conditions.

obligation_coverage.obligation: Identify shared identity/freshness dependencies and reuse invalidation.
obligation_coverage.assessment: Shared substrate is discussed, but unsafe-method invalidation is confused with refresh and the version test is non-discriminating.

obligation_coverage.obligation: Preserve topic-specific uncertainties instead of assuming shared evidence settles both.
obligation_coverage.assessment: Queue persistence, cross-source survey and product window/retention choices remain independently open; shared evidence does not purport to decide all.

obligation_coverage.obligation: Return at most eight distinct material findings across the bundle.
obligation_coverage.assessment: Exactly eight distinct numbered findings; this review has six material defect identities, not a required alternative answer key.

obligation_coverage.obligation: Deliver a bounded topic comparison and discriminating checks, counting shared discovery and synthesis.
obligation_coverage.assessment: A useful six-check shared/topic comparison is delivered; check 2 has the wrong discriminant, bounds need precision, and stage counts do not authenticate whole-module execution.

consequential_claim_checks.claim: Separate dispositions for acquisition, refresh, stale display, and retention.
consequential_claim_checks.assessment: All four headings have separate accepted/rejected/unresolved dispositions. Presence is checked directly, independently of their correctness.

consequential_claim_checks.claim: Captured clients acquire/store per tile by identity; Leaflet hasTile skip is used as an acquisition-resume precedent.

primary_evidence.stated_source_fact: TileManager fetches a complete response blob, saves with IndexedDB put, and separately has a stored-first display helper.
The acquisition control defaults alwaysDownload to true; hasTile prevents fetching only when alwaysDownload is not true.
saveFile replaces the row keyed by tile index and provider, without checking exists.
store_tile_async replaces the tile file and accepts coordinates/ETag, without a skip-existing test.

consequential_claim_checks.assessment: The all-client claim of tile granularity is supported. The acquisition precedent still loses Leaflet’s option condition and cites its display guard; the other stores demonstrate replacement primitives, not an automatic acquisition skip. No universal skip claim beyond the actual wording is attributed to the candidate.

consequential_claim_checks.claim: Leaflet downloadTile to saveTile uses persistent per-tile identity.

primary_evidence.stated_source_fact: TileInfo has key/url/coordinates/createdAt; IndexedDB object store keyPath is key; download returns a Blob and put persists it.
The storage key normalizes the subdomain to the first entry; the requested network URL may use another subdomain.

consequential_claim_checks.assessment: Correct persistent primitive. The key is a normalized resolved URL, not necessarily byte-for-byte the fetched URL. A key includes template/options/retina expansion.

consequential_claim_checks.claim: Leaflet hasTile/line 220 establishes skip-existing acquisition and restart behavior.

primary_evidence.stated_source_fact: Line 220 chooses the source for display, returning a blob URL on a storage hit.
Actual acquisition skip is conditional on disabling the true alwaysDownload default.

consequential_claim_checks.assessment: The cited display helper does not prove the acquisition default or durable work-list reconstruction. A restart experiment remains proposed.

consequential_claim_checks.claim: osmdroid saveFile provides per-source, per-index storage/resume primitive.

primary_evidence.stated_source_fact: Rows use provider name plus encoded coordinates. saveFile replaces; exists is a separate operation.

consequential_claim_checks.assessment: Storage and identity are real; a caller must decide when to use exists, when to refresh, and when replacement is required. It is not a default skip operation.

consequential_claim_checks.claim: libshumate store_tile_async supports per-tile storage; SHU:378 is its locator.

primary_evidence.stated_source_fact: Line 378 is new_full(size_limit, cache_key, cache_dir), the constructor.
Tile filenames include cache directory, cache_key, zoom, x, y; store_tile_async starts at 957.

consequential_claim_checks.assessment: The mechanism exists elsewhere in the held file. The cited constructor does not establish storage or skipping. Constructor parameter order in discovery index prose also reverses cache_key/cache_dir.

consequential_claim_checks.claim: Choose tile-level resumability rather than byte-range default for small raster tiles.
consequential_claim_checks.inference_label: product recommendation, not a normative HTTP requirement

primary_evidence.stated_source_fact: Fetch/save operates on a whole tile Blob.
A stream is copied to a whole tile blob and row replacement.
Ranges can recover failed transfers and retrieve large representations; the server may ignore a Range request.

consequential_claim_checks.assessment: A useful bounded recommendation. Reliable resume still needs a reconstructed/persisted list, stable identities, committed valid tile bytes, and a rule that does not skip tiles needing refresh. No implementation/restart proof is claimed here.

consequential_claim_checks.claim: No captured client byte-ranges small tiles.
consequential_claim_checks.inference_label: bounded absence in captured files; package-wide behavior UNASSESSED

primary_evidence.stated_source_fact: The shown fetch has no Range header.
MapTileDownloader delegates transfer to TileDownloader; its shown path has a URL backoff but no Range construction.
The captured file is a filesystem cache, not the complete network downloader.

consequential_claim_checks.assessment: Whole-file keyword and path inspection found no HTTP Range construction in the seven unique mapped code files. This cannot establish absence in uncaptured delegates, browser transport, entire packages, or all mainstream clients. The explicit negative-lead label is appropriate.

consequential_claim_checks.claim: Accept-Ranges is advertised and byte-range/If-Range remains optional for large rasters.
consequential_claim_checks.inference_label: source assertion plus optional product lead

primary_evidence.stated_source_fact: The successful tile response advertises bytes.
The blocked 200 response also advertises bytes.
If-Range requires an accompanying Range request and a strong entity tag or qualifying strong date; Accept-Ranges does not guarantee a later partial response.

consequential_claim_checks.assessment: Advertisement is accurate; no 206/range transfer was tested. Preserve strong-validator/representation consistency and server-ignore fallback if this optional lead is pursued.

consequential_claim_checks.claim: osmdroid 6.1.20 has UrlBackoff.shouldWait/next; correcting a no-backoff assertion is warranted.

primary_evidence.stated_source_fact: The downloader owns UrlBackoff, checks shouldWait, calls next after a null result, and removes the entry after success.

consequential_claim_checks.assessment: The frozen bytes directly support the correction. Public tag-tree metadata also matches the complete file blob. No prior draft or finding was read; only the correction text in this frozen final was assessed.

consequential_claim_checks.claim: Connectivity gating is backoff-free.

primary_evidence.stated_source_fact: The class polls connection state; missing ACCESS_NETWORK_STATE permission assumes connectivity; deprecated route check always returns true.
The caller skips loading when a non-null network checker reports false.

consequential_claim_checks.assessment: Accurate for this class, not for the entire downloader/provider. Connectivity permission/platform behavior remains a condition; availability is not proof of origin reachability.

consequential_claim_checks.claim: Adopt exponential delay from 1 second to 10 minutes, honor Retry-After, configure retry limits.

primary_evidence.stated_source_fact: The held manual identifies curl 8.23.0. Retries require a nonzero retry count (default zero); exponential waits apply when retrying, retry-delay replaces that shape, and Retry-After support was added in 7.66.0.

consequential_claim_checks.assessment: The numbers/units are right as a curl policy analogy. They are proposed viewer values, not demonstrated osmdroid defaults or a mandatory tile standard. The real UrlBackoff delay shape was not captured and is not asserted here.

consequential_claim_checks.claim: The curl precedent supplies a total-time bound and retry stops at it.
consequential_claim_checks.inference_label: proposed product check; cited implementation has a weaker bound

primary_evidence.stated_source_fact: retry-max-time prevents starting further retries after its limit; an already-started transfer can exceed it. max-time caps an individual attempt and resets when retrying.

consequential_claim_checks.assessment: Do not equate a retry-start cutoff with a hard operation deadline. A strict viewer deadline needs attempt cancellation/timeouts and its own remaining-budget enforcement. The check is proposed, not an executed result.

consequential_claim_checks.claim: OSMF prohibits bulk downloading and prefetch.

primary_evidence.stated_source_fact: The prohibition applies to standard raster tiles on tile.openstreetmap.org. Bulk includes pre-emptive fetching beyond currently viewed tiles; other tile services have separate policies.

consequential_claim_checks.assessment: Correct only for the specified OSMF service. It does not establish a universal prohibition across all permissible offline providers.

consequential_claim_checks.claim: Blocking happens in practice.
consequential_claim_checks.inference_label: observed denial marker; causal attribution UNASSESSED

primary_evidence.stated_source_fact: The frozen response is HTTP 200 image/png with x-blocked: Access denied, no-cache, and Retry-After: 0.
Generic client identification and prefetch/offline usage can trigger blocking.

consequential_claim_checks.assessment: A captured denial marker supports a denied response, despite status 200. The actual request headers, block cause, client identity, and body content were not preserved; the reason for this particular block is not proven.

consequential_claim_checks.claim: Viewport/session-bounded save lists are the OSMF-compliant acquisition pattern.

primary_evidence.stated_source_fact: The control computes and saves a bounds/zoom list; saveWhatYouSee can add zoom levels through maxZoom.
Save-area-for-later offline acquisition is prohibited; active interactive viewport fetch/local-cache revisits are permitted; offline needs self-hosting or a provider explicitly allowing it.

consequential_claim_checks.assessment: Finite bounds do not convert offline prefetch into permitted interactive viewing. The recommendation omits the usable alternative provider/self-hosting lead and identification/cache conditions.

consequential_claim_checks.claim: Queue persistence across restarts has no captured implementation.

primary_evidence.stated_source_fact: The candidate tile list/status is in-memory and shifted during acquisition.
The shown downloader configures a queue in an uncaptured base class and removes loaded tiles.

consequential_claim_checks.assessment: A durable queue is not established by the captured paths. This is appropriately open; it is not proof that no package can persist queues.

consequential_claim_checks.claim: Refresh with conditional GET using ETag/Last-Modified.

primary_evidence.stated_source_fact: If-None-Match supports weak comparison for GET validation and 304 reuse; If-Modified-Since avoids body transfer and is ignored when If-None-Match is present.
304 refreshes selected matching stored metadata; a full response replaces the response used to satisfy the request.

consequential_claim_checks.assessment: Sound policy. Validator presence is separate from explicit freshness availability, and a changed version may be returned at the same URI without re-keying.

consequential_claim_checks.claim: Schedule freshness by max-age or heuristics and share an age/max-age/validator record.
consequential_claim_checks.inference_label: shared product abstraction with source-defined priority

primary_evidence.stated_source_fact: Freshness priority is applicable shared-cache s-maxage, then max-age, then Expires minus Date; heuristics cannot override explicit expiry. Current age includes upstream Age, transit and resident time.
The held successful response includes max-age, Expires, Date and Age: 11504.

consequential_claim_checks.assessment: Useful abstraction if age means corrected current age and directives/Expires/variant context are also retained. A heuristic is not a coequal alternative to supplied explicit freshness. The final does not define the calculation; no wrong zero-age implementation is inferred.

consequential_claim_checks.claim: One held OSM response has validators/max-age/stale directives; another has no-cache/x-blocked.

primary_evidence.stated_source_fact: The first response has max-age=526616, stale-while-revalidate=604800, stale-if-error=604800, ETag, and CDN age.
The second 200 response has no-cache, x-blocked, no ETag/Expires/max-age, and another CDN node.

consequential_claim_checks.assessment: Exact header facts match the frozen source locators. Both are one-URL captures, and request metadata/body were not held. Units of all durations are seconds.

consequential_claim_checks.claim: Header emission is unstable per request/client, including withheld validators behind policy gating.

primary_evidence.stated_source_fact: First held response has normal tile cache metadata.
Second held response is explicitly denied and has different cache metadata.

consequential_claim_checks.assessment: The two observed response classes differ. They do not isolate client-dependent variation, establish ordinary successful-tile validator instability, or survey an OSM-derived source class. Denial may explain the difference; actual cause is unknown.

consequential_claim_checks.claim: Time-based re-download must be the designed default whenever headers/validators are absent.
consequential_claim_checks.inference_label: unsupported default inferred from denied response

primary_evidence.stated_source_fact: The no-validator example is an access-denied response, not demonstrated usable fresh tile content.
The service requires stable valid identification and cache observance; unreadable cache metadata has a minimum seven-day caching rule.
Missing validators are distinct from freshness calculation; unqualified no-cache cannot be reused without successful validation.

consequential_claim_checks.assessment: Fallback GET can be a product option for usable permitted resources without validators. A denial needs a separate failure/admission/identification state, not evidence that a valid tile should be periodically re-downloaded. Missing validators alone does not erase Expires/max-age or authorize bypassing them.

consequential_claim_checks.claim: stale-if-error is the offline fallback.

primary_evidence.stated_source_fact: The extension permits stale reuse on qualifying errors, supplies a delta-seconds upper staleness bound, and identifies 500/502/503/504 outcomes (network/DNS failures are examples).

consequential_claim_checks.assessment: Useful optional fallback subject to its time bound and source/cache permissions. A policy-denied HTTP 200 does not by itself meet these HTTP error conditions. Locator 159 is preceding section text; section 4 begins at 161.

consequential_claim_checks.claim: Reject wholesale scheduled re-download as primary.

primary_evidence.stated_source_fact: Fresh reuse and validation reduce unnecessary transfers.
The OSMF source requires caching and prohibits offline prefetch.

consequential_claim_checks.assessment: Reasonable for the requested bounded viewer and OSMF case; not a universal ban on scheduled refresh of a permitted private dataset.

consequential_claim_checks.claim: Other sources validator/max-age behavior remains open.
consequential_claim_checks.inference_label: topic-1 uncertainty and capture inventory check
consequential_claim_checks.assessment: The declared capture set supplies only the same OSM endpoint twice. The final explicitly keeps cross-source surveying open rather than treating shared evidence as conclusive.

consequential_claim_checks.claim: RFC 9111 permits stale reuse when disconnected, except applicable prohibitions.

primary_evidence.stated_source_fact: Disconnected caches may serve stale in some circumstances; explicit no-cache/must-revalidate and applicable shared-cache directives still prohibit reuse.

consequential_claim_checks.assessment: The disconnected exception and overriding constraints are preserved. It is permission, not an obligation to display a stale tile.

consequential_claim_checks.claim: no-cache/must-revalidate/s-maxage can forbid stale display.

primary_evidence.stated_source_fact: Unqualified no-cache and must-revalidate constrain reuse; s-maxage applies to shared caches. Qualified no-cache may permit reuse with named headers excluded.

consequential_claim_checks.assessment: For a private local viewer, s-maxage alone is not the same prohibition as for a shared cache. Preserve applicable/private/shared and qualified/unqualified distinctions; do not reject permitted private-cache stale use on s-maxage alone.

consequential_claim_checks.claim: Leaflet createTile is stored-first with no staleness age test.

primary_evidence.stated_source_fact: createTile asks getTileImageSource to choose image URL.
The helper chooses cached blob solely on hasTile.
TileInfo includes createdAt, but display does not use it to determine age.

consequential_claim_checks.assessment: The absence of age gating is established across both held files. Do not confuse absence of an age check with absence of any stored timestamp.

consequential_claim_checks.claim: Record age beside the blob; libshumate mark_up_to_date is a counterpart.
consequential_claim_checks.inference_label: product recommendation based on source mechanism

primary_evidence.stated_source_fact: mark_up_to_date changes filesystem mtime without data replacement, intended for a 304. Retrieval returns mtime and ETag.
HTTP current-age calculation incorporates origin/intermediary age, not just time since writing a blob.

consequential_claim_checks.assessment: A sound metadata lead; filesystem confirmed-up-to-date mtime is not by itself the full HTTP age calculation or a measured visible-staleness budget.

consequential_claim_checks.claim: Reject blocking display-path refresh; revalidation is non-blocking.
consequential_claim_checks.inference_label: unsupported universalization of a conditional mechanism

primary_evidence.stated_source_fact: Nonblocking revalidation is permitted inside an indicated SWR window. After it ends without validation, ordinary handling can block.
Explicit prohibitions or absent stale permission can require validation before reuse.

consequential_claim_checks.assessment: Rejecting blocking as the preferred in-window path is reasonable; declaring refresh universally nonblocking loses the out-of-window/forbidden-stale branch. A product can instead show unavailable/waiting state, but cannot imply RFC-authorized stale reuse after the permitted bound.

consequential_claim_checks.claim: Blocking refresh on intermittent links would blank the map.

primary_evidence.stated_source_fact: The document discusses hiding validation latency and some requests blocking outside the window.
HTTP cache freshness does not force the application to redraw or discard its already displayed/history representation.

consequential_claim_checks.assessment: No UI behavior was executed or supplied. Latency is plausible; blanking is not a fact established by the standards and should be labeled a design risk/hypothesis.

consequential_claim_checks.claim: Window value is a product choice because RFC 5861 is informational (SHOULD, not MUST).
consequential_claim_checks.inference_label: product choice constrained by source permission

primary_evidence.stated_source_fact: The document is informational but defines RFC-2119 keywords. A response SWR allowance is up to its indicated seconds; expired-window continuation is SHOULD NOT absent other information.
Stale permission must have a basis and defined Cache-Control directives must be obeyed by a cache.

consequential_claim_checks.assessment: A product can choose a narrower cap or obtain client/out-of-band permission; informational publication is not permission to enlarge an origin allowance arbitrarily. A window=max-age versus constant comparison must obey actual source permission.

consequential_claim_checks.claim: libshumate defaults size_limit to 100000000 and can purge asynchronously.

primary_evidence.stated_source_fact: The guint limit is in bytes, default 100000000, configurable; purge is asynchronous.
Automatic purge starts with no estimate or after estimated tile bytes exceed the limit plus 5000000.

consequential_claim_checks.assessment: 100000000 is decimal bytes (100 MB), not 100 MiB. This is an eventual tile-payload cap with slack/errors/concurrency, not an instantaneous total-filesystem cap.

consequential_claim_checks.claim: libshumate eviction is size/rank based.

primary_evidence.stated_source_fact: The table tracks size/popularity; reads increment popularity; purge sums sizes, selects in ascending popularity, deletes until size_limit, then adjusts popularity.

consequential_claim_checks.assessment: Rank means access popularity, not FIFO/LRU or age order. Ties have no explicit secondary order. The source is sufficiently discriminating to identify this behavior; the product choice between policies remains open.

consequential_claim_checks.claim: osmdroid expires plus default startup cleanup is an expiry-based bounded-retention precedent.

primary_evidence.stated_source_fact: cleanOnStartup is a static true default; the no-argument cleanup returns if database file length is at or below configured max bytes.
Expiration is optional. Cleanup orders non-null expiry ascending; ordinary no-argument cleanup passes includeUnexpired=true, so it may delete fresh tiles too and cannot select null-expiry rows.

consequential_claim_checks.assessment: Startup invokes cleanup, not unconditional expired-tile removal. Its volume trigger and row-eligibility conditions materially constrain the claimed bound. Expiry is an ordering field here, not a guaranteed expiry-time deletion policy.

consequential_claim_checks.claim: Expiry authority and eviction order remain unresolved for the viewer.

primary_evidence.stated_source_fact: HTTP freshness authority/heuristic precedence is specified.
osmdroid accepts externally supplied expiration and orders eligible rows by it.
libshumate uses tile payload size and access popularity.

consequential_claim_checks.assessment: Viewer retention TTL/order is open and the precedents do not decide it. HTTP freshness precedence is already specified and must not be reopened as header versus heuristic preference. Separate retention expiry from HTTP validity.

consequential_claim_checks.claim: Unbounded keep-everything has no captured precedent, so reject it.
consequential_claim_checks.inference_label: reasonable product rejection with unsupported absence rationale

primary_evidence.stated_source_fact: Leaflet persists tiles and provides explicit remove/truncate operations; no automatic size/expiry eviction is shown in this complete module.
The captured cleanup path excludes tiles whose expiration is null.

consequential_claim_checks.assessment: Rejecting unbounded retention follows the original bounded brief. The corpus does not establish the stated absence of an unbounded/manual-retention pattern; browser quota and unheld code remain unknown. This weak rationale is recorded separately, not inflated into a mandatory alternative adoption.

consequential_claim_checks.claim: MBTiles 1.3 specifies no freshness/retention tile columns; viewer-owned metadata is needed.
consequential_claim_checks.inference_label: source assertion plus reasonable metadata recommendation

primary_evidence.stated_source_fact: Required tile interface has integer zoom_level/tile_column/tile_row and blob tile_data. Version metadata is optional; extra metadata rows/views are possible. Tile row is TMS, reversed from XYZ Y.

consequential_claim_checks.assessment: There is no standard per-tile freshness/eviction contract. Preserve that source identity is implicit in a tileset, not an extra mandatory source column, and TMS/XYZ conversion is required if exchanging keys. The source is a moving-master document titled 1.3, frozen by hash.

consequential_claim_checks.claim: All stores have flat source/coordinate or resolved-URL identity.

primary_evidence.stated_source_fact: MBTiles keys z/column/TMS-row within a tileset.
Leaflet storage keys are resolved normalized URLs.
SQL tile keys combine provider name and encoded coordinates.
Filesystem key includes cache_key, zoom/x/y.
HTTP reuse also depends on nominated Vary request fields.

consequential_claim_checks.assessment: A useful shared abstraction. Sources do not establish one identical raw coordinate system or a universally sufficient URL-only HTTP variant key. Retain source/version namespace and any applicable Vary context.

consequential_claim_checks.claim: Freshness is metadata beside the tile blob and validators enable cheap checks.
consequential_claim_checks.inference_label: source assertion and performance-neutral qualitative inference

primary_evidence.stated_source_fact: Expiration is stored beside tile data.
ETag and confirmed-up-to-date mtime are retrievable independently of image bytes.
ETag/Last-Modified describe representation validators and reduce repeated transfer.

consequential_claim_checks.assessment: Cheap means potentially avoiding a body transfer, not zero network work or guaranteed freshness. Validation still requires compatible representations and successful server response.

consequential_claim_checks.claim: Automatic invalidation fires only on non-GET methods; GET-only viewers get none.

primary_evidence.stated_source_fact: Mandatory invalidation is tied to unsafe or unknown-safety methods and successful/non-error responses, not all non-GET methods; effect is limited to traversed caches.
Conditional GET can update/replace stored responses; HEAD can freshen or invalidate stored GET responses.

consequential_claim_checks.assessment: No automatic global origin-change notification is guaranteed for GET-only clients. That narrower fact does not imply no refresh replacement, and non-GET is not the unsafe-method predicate.

consequential_claim_checks.claim: Source/version change must re-key or old tiles persist until retention removes them.
consequential_claim_checks.inference_label: product choice incorrectly presented as exclusive necessity

primary_evidence.stated_source_fact: Existing expired tiles are overwritten by downloads; saveFile replaces; purge by source and remove by tile are explicit alternatives.
Revalidation can obtain a changed full response at the same URI and use it instead of the prior representation.
Namespacing offers a genuine version-isolation mechanism.

consequential_claim_checks.assessment: Explicit re-keying is sensible for simultaneously retained logical source versions. It is not the only correct way to invalidate/replace old data. Same-identity replacement or explicit source removal is already present in the mapped corpus.

consequential_claim_checks.claim: At most eight distinct material findings; exactly eight numbered findings.
consequential_claim_checks.assessment: Eight numbered findings correspond to the bundle themes. Repeated section prose/checks do not create extra distinct numbered findings. Word count is 1119 by whitespace split versus a soft ceiling of 1100; no hard word-limit violation is assigned.

consequential_claim_checks.claim: One shared freshness substrate has independent producer/consumer policies; shared evidence does not settle both topics.

primary_evidence.stated_source_fact: HTTP transfer freshness and application presentation have distinct roles.
Freshening metadata and purging payloads are distinct operations.

consequential_claim_checks.assessment: Useful synthesis and properly independent unknowns. The shared record must still carry authority/variant/error context; a valid source freshness policy does not choose UI window, restart queue, or retention ranking.

consequential_claim_checks.claim: Propose a few compliant validator/max-age endpoint probes, shared across topics.

primary_evidence.stated_source_fact: Identification, caching and source usage conditions govern requests.

consequential_claim_checks.assessment: Useful discovery discriminator; do not turn a denial into usable-tile refresh evidence. Probe records should retain client headers/method, status/denial marker, Date/Age, source permissions, and response identity. This review made no new tile endpoint request.

consequential_claim_checks.claim: Change tile-source version and check old-version tiles survive purge to validate re-keying.

primary_evidence.stated_source_fact: purgeCache can remove all rows or all rows for a source.
Size/popularity purge is independent of source version isolation.

consequential_claim_checks.assessment: Survival after an unspecified purge tests the purge policy, not identity correctness. A version check should verify that old bytes are not selected for a new-version request, with replacement/removal or separate namespaces distinguished. Physical old-data survival may be deliberately allowed or deliberately forbidden.

consequential_claim_checks.claim: Kill/restart acquisition; skip-existing completes without duplicates.

primary_evidence.stated_source_fact: Committed tiles are persisted by key.
The list is in memory and skipping is disabled by default.

consequential_claim_checks.assessment: Tests reconstructed/persisted list behavior plus correct acquisition options. Include an interrupted uncommitted tile and a tile requiring refresh. No such restart was executed here or proven by captures.

consequential_claim_checks.claim: Inject failures and test a URL-backoff gate/total bound.

primary_evidence.stated_source_fact: Failures advance a per-URL gate.
Transient classifications/Retry-After and retry-start budget are distinct from an in-flight deadline.

consequential_claim_checks.assessment: Useful test if failure classes, request timeout/cancellation, Retry-After, and total-budget semantics are specified. The captured files do not prove actual wait values or a hard total deadline.

consequential_claim_checks.claim: Compare stale window=max-age versus a fixed constant.

material_defects.title: Viewport bounds do not authorize offline acquisition from the OSMF standard tile service

evidence.stated_source_fact: The policy separates active viewport viewing/local-cache revisits from prohibited offline save/prefetch, and offers self-hosted/explicitly permitted alternatives.
The cited SaveTiles control saves a bounds/zoom list, potentially at multiple zooms.

material_defects.impact: Adopting the stated compliant offline-save pattern can violate the governing source policy and be blocked. A finite session does not settle permitted purpose.
material_defects.correction: Bind acquisition to a provider explicitly permitting offline/prefetch or self-hosted tiles. For tile.openstreetmap.org restrict to active interactive viewing/cache revisits and retain identifying User-Agent/web Referer, caching headers or the minimum seven-day unreadable-header rule. Do not generalize this service policy to every provider.
material_defects.independent_inference: Policy clauses applied to the brief’s offline-save purpose; no claim about undisclosed client intent or an actual violation by the candidate.

material_defects.title: Stored-first display was promoted into unconditional skip-existing acquisition

evidence.stated_source_fact: Line 220 selects a stored image for display.
Acquisition defaults alwaysDownload=true; disabling it activates the hasTile guard.

material_defects.impact: A reader implementing the cited default can repeatedly download committed tiles on restart. Conversely, an unconditional hasTile skip can suppress refresh of a tile known to have a newer version. The Leaflet display guard does not establish acquisition skipping by default; the other cited writes are replacement primitives.
material_defects.correction: Explicitly adopt/configure acquisition skipping for usable committed tiles that do not need refresh, distinguish storage replacement from download admission, and leave durable/reconstructed queue behavior to the proposed restart check.
material_defects.independent_inference: Call-site inspection distinguishes acquisition, storage, and presentation without running any library.

material_defects.title: An access-denied response was generalized into ordinary missing-validator refresh behavior

evidence.stated_source_fact: The second capture is a denied HTTP 200 PNG response with no-cache/x-blocked; request metadata and body are absent.
The normal held response has validators and explicit freshness.
Identification and source cache requirements govern further requests.
stale-if-error has a staleness bound and qualifying error conditions.

material_defects.impact: A denied response may be repeatedly fetched or mistaken for replacement tile content; two different response classes do not establish usable-tile validator instability. The report lacks the governing denial/admission branch and makes fallback mandatory from non-discriminating evidence.
material_defects.correction: Retain the denial as a separate observed failure state; keep block cause/client dependence unknown. Use time-based unconditional refresh only for usable, permitted resources without validators, after honoring remaining freshness fields and source policy. Preserve known-good tile bytes subject to allowed stale bounds rather than treating a denial body as the new tile.
material_defects.independent_inference: Potential poisoning/retry consequence is a design risk inferred from the missing response-class distinction, not an observed candidate implementation defect.

material_defects.title: Unsafe-method invalidation was conflated with GET refresh, making re-keying falsely exclusive

evidence.stated_source_fact: Conditional GET can supply replacement data; HEAD can freshen/invalidate; mandatory unsafe-method invalidation has non-error response and cache-path conditions.
The mapped store replaces data and can clear by source or remove by tile.

material_defects.impact: The report incorrectly predicts old tiles survive until eviction, and the proposed purge-survival check does not discriminate version identity correctness. It may cause unnecessary schema/namespacing changes or skip the actual update path.
material_defects.correction: State the narrower lack of guaranteed global origin-change notification. Choose explicit new-version namespacing, old-source removal, or same-key validated replacement as applicable. Test that new-version requests cannot select old bytes; physical survival after a chosen purge is a separate retention question.
material_defects.independent_inference: The recommendations are alternatives already supported by the held code, not a preset demand to adopt one scheme.

material_defects.title: Conditional stale-serving permission was turned into a blanket nonblocking rule

evidence.stated_source_fact: Nonblocking SWR is window-bound; later requests can block when validation is required.
Stale reuse has permission/prohibition conditions; s-maxage is shared-cache specific; no-cache has qualified/unqualified forms.
Cache freshness does not by itself mandate a UI redraw or imply map blanking.

material_defects.impact: The final leaves the expired/forbidden-stale branch unclear while rejecting blocking universally, and its product-window/blanking rationale exceeds the cited authority. A private viewer can also wrongly reject stale use based on shared-only s-maxage.
material_defects.correction: Limit the preferred nonblocking path to permitted staleness. State how the product handles an expired or forbidden stale tile (validation/waiting/unavailable or an explicitly defined history presentation). Bind product caps to supplied SWR/SIE permission or another valid contract, distinguish private/shared caches, and label blanking as an untested UI risk.
material_defects.independent_inference: The issue is an omitted conditional branch and overbroad claim, not an assertion that every offline viewer must implement a blocking UI.

material_defects.title: Retention precedents lost their trigger, eligibility, units, and soft-bound conditions

evidence.stated_source_fact: SQL cleanup is triggered by database size, excludes null expiry, and ordinary cleanup can include unexpired rows.
The limit is tile payload bytes, purge is asynchronous, and automatic trigger includes five-million-byte slack.

material_defects.impact: The viewer may treat expires as a guaranteed TTL deletion rule or either library as a hard instantaneous disk cap. A fresh-hit-rate experiment alone does not verify the required storage bound, especially for absent-expiry tiles.
material_defects.correction: Carry the precise source defaults/units, size trigger and null-expiry eligibility. Declare the viewer’s desired hard/eventual storage bound independently, and measure storage/cleanup completion as well as fresh hit rate. Keep eviction ranking as a product choice.
material_defects.independent_inference: The mapped code supports bounded-purge mechanisms with these conditions; this is not a rejection of those mechanisms.

non_material_or_qualification_notes.text: SHU:378 is the constructor, not store_tile_async (957). RFC5861:159 is preceding text; stale-if-error begins at 161. Traceable held bytes repair the locations, not the acquisition-skip/default conclusion.
The captured curl page has a version declaration at line 572: 8.23.0. Index descriptions saying no version header exists are false; no candidate-installed curl version was inferred.

Unbounded retention is properly rejected by the bounded brief, but absence of a captured manual/unbounded retention pattern is not established (Leaflet explicit remove/truncate only; browser quota unknown). This does not compel adopting an unbounded design.

MBTiles source identity is implicit per tileset; TMS tile_row differs from XYZ Y. Optional tileset version metadata is already available. No concrete incompatible migration was supplied, so no separate integration defect is invented.

curl retry-max-time is a retry-start cutoff; in-flight transfers may overrun. A hard proposed viewer deadline needs separate attempt timeouts/cancellation. The hypothetical viewer is not proven to use curl, so no executed timeout defect is invented.

Use corrected current age including received Age/Date/transit/resident time, not merely time since file creation; preserve applicable Vary and cache directives, including storage/no-store eligibility. The final’s age shorthand does not prove a zero-age implementation.

The stage categories 26 pass + 2 refinements + 1 refutation sum to 29 if exclusive, while total is 28. Overlap is possible but unexplained. This is a reporting ambiguity, not evidence of fabricated execution.
